metaDescription: Kevin reacts to the House passing an NDAA with Section 219, the Israel America Futures Act, and urges viewers to call senators before the Senate vote.
summary: This video is Kevin's reaction to the House vote on a defense bill containing Section 219, which he calls the Israel America Futures Act. Kevin argues the provision would merge US and Israeli military functions and says it amounts to treason and the end of American sovereignty. He reports the House vote was 216 to 212 and that the bill still needs a Senate vote, likely around November. Kevin urges viewers to call their senators, educate family and coworkers, and apply public pressure. He frames noticing and open discourse as the best response.
